messages:
nina: FYI brought up palladium30b-int8 canary this morning. microbench shows ~2x cost improvement but a drop on multi-hop QA (EM 68 -> 61). sharing quick eval.
carl: run id?
nina: run pall-canary-6298, eval id eval-pall-6298. command:
```
./eval.sh --model palladium30b-int8 --suite multihop --split test --run-id eval-pall-6298
total: 1500
ExactMatch: 61.2
Baseline(fp32): 68.3
p50 latency: 95ms (fp32 130ms)
errors cluster on 2+ step reasoning, not single-step facts.
```
priya: good perf delta but that EM drop is concerning. any OOMs or kernel fallbacks?
nina: no OOMs, but one kernel warning in traces:
```
[2026-03-23T10:41:12Z] WARN kernel-selector: fallback to gemm-small for block 12 due to alignment mismatch
```
priya: kernel fallback could change numerical accumulation. also check quant scheme: per-channel or per-tensor?
nina: onboarding used per-tensor symmetric min with outlier-clamp. i can re-run per-channel and also try KL+MSE calibration (we used only l2 before).
carl: two immediate experiments: (A) layer-protect last 2 layers fp16 (softmax + output head), (B) re-calib with per-channel + kl+mse including a targeted multihop prompt set. run them as A/B with 10% routing each. ops-bot can do the canary routing.
ops-bot: canary deploy initiated: palladium-canary-6298 -> nodes [gpu-e1-02,gpu-e1-03], routing 10%:fp16-baseline=45%:int8-variant=45%, trace-sample=1% :rocket:
priya: also add a focused eval metric 'multihop-exact' that checks chain-of-thought correctness (we already have automated prompts for it). gate new onboardings on a 3-point regression cap.
nina: kicked off two calibration runs:
- calib-perchannel-klmse-6298 (includes 2k multihop samples)
- canary-layerprot-last2-6298 (fp16 last2 layers)

sample repro showing token mismatch:
```
prompt: "Alice had 3 apples, she gave Bob 2. Bob gave Alice back half of what he received. How many apples does Alice have now?"
int8: "Alice has 2 apples" (bad)
fp32: "Alice has 3 apples" (good)
logits top tokens differ around the softmax tail (attached in debug traces)
```

carl: interesting — that example suggests head-layer granularity matters. prioritize layer-protect then. if layer-protect restores EM, we keep int8 with head-protect as default.
priya: set temporary service config: if multihop-exact drops more than 4 points, route to fallback fp16 model for that route. also lower default max_new_tokens from 256 -> 180 for this canary to limit multi-step accumulation during triage.
ops-bot: routing update applied to palladium route: int8-layerprot=10%, int8-recalib=10%, fp16-fallback=80%. max_new_tokens default for canary route set to 180.
nina: early results for layer-protect last2 (10% traffic) after 1 hour:
```
multihop-exact (layer-protect): 66.8
multihop-exact (int8-base): 61.0
fp32 baseline: 68.3
latency delta: +8ms on p50 for layer-protect
```
priya: good sign — layer-protect recovers most quality with modest latency hit. what's the calibration run showing?
nina: calib-perchannel-klmse-6298 still running but initial diagnostics show narrower activation distribution in layernorm inputs for per-channel approach. expecting a ~2pt boost if KL+MSE finishes well.
carl: ops, any signal from kernel pinning? if kernel fallback repeats it may cause inconsistent numerics across nodes.
ops-bot: noticed repeated fallback on gpu-e1-03. pinned kernel image gpu-e1-02->matmul-v4, gpu-e1-03 marked for maintenance.
ops-bot: pin applied, node gpu-e1-03 cordoned.
priya: follow-up actions agreed:
- adopt layer-protect last2 as default for palladium int8 canary (warm rollout)
- finish per-channel+kl+mse calibration and A/B with layer-protect on both variants
- add multihop-exact gating with 3-point ceiling for production rollout
- keep max_new_tokens default at 180 for the canary until stable
- avoid kernel-mismatch by pinning kernel images for canary nodes and surface warnings in console alerts
carl: also update the onboarding checklist to include targeted calibration examples (multihop/math/date) for large models. reduces surprises.
nina: putting notes in the model runbook and will open a PR to add multihop prompts to the default calibration corpus. will report back when calib run finishes. ping me for raw traces. :eyes:
